description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Saproling tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Saprolings die, Slimefoot triggers twice, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
